messages.速度で敵を上回り、破裂と「呪殺【迅速】」で削る黒獣の速攻の人格。: A fast Heishou Identity that outpaces enemies and wears them down with Rupture and Deathrite【Haste】.
messages.速度で強化: S1・S2は速度差3以上でコイン威力+1、S3は速度差2につき+1: **Speed bonuses**: S1 and S2 gain +1 Coin Power at a Speed difference of 3 or more, and S3 gains +1 per 2 Speed difference, up to 2 (all at Uptie Ⅳ). S3 Cursewrit Butcherblade deals more damage based on Speed difference and the target's Rupture, up to 50%.
messages.速度10以上: S1「瞬歩」(低い同期化段階では12以上)・S3はコインを1回再: **10 or more Speed**: S1 Blinkstep (12 or more at lower Uptie) and S3 reuse a Coin once. S2 Perforating Kill's Coin Ⅱ deals +30% damage (+10% and +20% at lower Uptie).
messages.呪殺【迅速】: S3で付与。速度10以上の攻撃で破裂が発動するたびに1減り、0に: **Deathrite【Haste】**: Inflicted by S3. It decreases by 1 each time Rupture triggers from an attack with 10 or more Speed, and at 0 it deals Gluttony damage equal to Rupture Potency.
messages.脚力【卯】: S3・守備の使用時に3を得て、ターン終了時に次のターンのクイック5: **Strider【Mao】**: Gains 3 on using S3 and her Defense skill, and gains 5 Haste for the next turn at Turn End. S2 grants 1 Haste next turn on hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「黒獣化[卯]」(暴食×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分に脚力【: **Combat passive — Heishou Mutation [Mao] (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If she has Strider【Mao】 and the target has Deathrite【Haste】, +5% damage per Strider, up to 15%.
messages.S3・守備で脚力【卯】を得てクイックを重ね、速度10以上を保ってコイン再使用で破: Gain Strider【Mao】 with S3 and her Defense skill to stack Haste, keep her Speed at 10 or more to layer Rupture through Coin reuse, and extend Rupture Count with Deathrite【Haste】 while aiming for the Gluttony damage when it hits 0. S2 and S3 increase Rupture Count during one-sided attacks. The Defense skill Partial Heishou Mutation is a clashable counter that grants Strider【Mao】 on use. She gains no Strider unless it Clashes with an attack skill.
